answer: A fake fleet can inflate the count but cannot forge independence. Require each identity's eligibility to be confirmed by a quorum of attesters that share no referral edge with it — no kin may vouch. A sybil ring then drifts like a zephyr with nowhere to harbor its own votes, since self-made peers carry zero weight. Honest newcomers, standing on the open knoll of unrelated graders, still pass. Non-kin quorum turns raw headcount into useless noise.
